title: Boosting Knowledge Graph Foundation Models via Enhanced Negative Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2605.27023v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Knowledge graphs (KGs) have become the core backbone of numerous downstream tasks such as question answering and recommender systems. However, despite all this, KGs are often very incomplete. To perform zero-shot knowledge graph completion in unseen KGs, which have different relational vocabularies from those used for pre-training, KG foundation models (KGFMs) receive a wide range of attention. Existing KGFMs often perform training using random negative triples, which are constructed by replacing the head or tail entity of a positive triple with a random entity. However, these negative triples are often constructed with limited quality, providing weak supervision for KGFM training. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective adaptive negative sampling approach, KMAS, to enhance existing KGFMs. KMAS constructs hard negative triples through the updated relation embeddings generated from the existing KGFM's relation encoder. translated_title: 通过增强负采样提升知识图谱基础模型
translated_abstract: 知识图谱（KGs）已成为问答系统和推荐系统等众多下游任务的核心支柱。然而，尽管如此，知识图谱往往非常不完整。为了在关系词汇表与预训练时不同的未见知识图谱上执行零样本知识图谱补全，知识图谱基础模型受到了广泛关注。现有的知识图谱基础模型通常使用随机负三元组进行训练，这些负三元组是通过用随机实体替换正三元组的头实体或尾实体来构建的。然而，这些负三元组的构建质量往往有限，为知识图谱基础模型的训练提供的监督信号较弱。在本文中，我们提出了一种简单而有效的自适应负采样方法KMAS，以增强现有的知识图谱基础模型。KMAS利用现有知识图谱基础模型关系编码器生成的更新后的关系嵌入来构建困难负三元组。为进一步……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种简单有效的自适应负采样方法KMAS，通过利用关系编码器生成的更新关系嵌入来构建高质量困难负三元组，从而增强知识图谱基础模型的训练效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes KMAS, a simple yet effective adaptive negative sampling approach that enhances knowledge graph foundation models by constructing hard negative triples through updated relation embeddings from the existing KGFM's relation encoder.
